personality_one_liner: A premium, photography-first editorial layout that feels like a high-end printed magazine, prioritizing warm emotional memories.

spacing.rule: Generous magazine-like vertical rhythm. Let typography and photos breathe. Do not cramp elements.

do's: Use only if strictly required for sticky bottom CTA floating over a busy photo grid
dont's: Avoid glassmorphism on general UI elements to maintain the flat, printed paper editorial feel.

screens.name: Onboarding & Login
screens.purpose: Evoke emotion and trust while capturing the user's mobile number via OTP.

states.loading: Subtle activity indicator near the button.
states.error: Inline red text below the mobile/OTP input field.

screens.layout: Full-bleed photography hero image (top 60%) showcasing beautiful memories. A vertical gradient scrim (transparent to surfaceInverse) ensures bottom area blends. The bottom 40% houses a white (surfaceSecondary) sheet with large Playfair Display heading, standard text input for mobile, and a full-width brandPrimary CTA button for WhatsApp/SMS OTP.

screens.name: Home Dashboard
screens.purpose: Central hub for the customer to start a new album or view past orders/drafts.

states.loading: Skeleton blocks matching the editorial cards.
states.empty: Empty state illustration of a blank polaroid or vintage camera, inviting them to create their first book.
states.error: Simple text message with a 'Retry' text link.

screens.layout: Header with 'ClickBook' wordmark (Playfair). Large featured hero card 'Create a new ClickBook' with a premium background image. Below, horizontal scrollable sections for 'My Drafts' and 'Previous Orders'. Cards use sharp/sm radius with 1px border and no shadow.

screens.name: Create Flow (Cover & Upload)
screens.purpose: Select book properties and upload photos seamlessly.

states.loading: Full-screen minimal loader: 'Designing your album...' with a subtle fade animation.
states.error: Toast or inline message for upload failures.

screens.layout: Step 1: Horizontal carousel of large cover option cards (Linen, Hardcover). Step 2: Photo upload grid (3-column) with a sticky 'Next' CTA anchored to the bottom. Step 3: Loading screen transitioning to the 3D Preview.

screens.name: Editor & 3D Preview
screens.purpose: Review the auto-generated layout and tweak properties before ordering.

states.error: Error loading high-res images fallback to low-res.

screens.layout: Top 60% of screen: Sticky live preview area (Reanimated page flip). Bottom 40%: Gorhom Bottom Sheet. Top of the sheet has an icon row (Background, Layout, Pages, Text). Tapping one expands its options (e.g., color swatches) within the sheet.

screens.name: Checkout & Order Tracking
screens.purpose: Summarize cost, accept coupons, and track delivery with playful process bots.
screens.layout: Checkout: Clean editorial receipt style. Line items for sheets (₹90 * count) and GST. Inline coupon field. Sticky 'Pay Now' button. Tracking: Vertical timeline on surfaceTertiary. Nodes are active/inactive circles. Uses 'process bots' (Feather icons like 'printer', 'package', 'truck' inside brandTertiary circles) for active stages.

screens.name: Admin Dashboard & Management
screens.purpose: Manage business operations, orders, and app settings.
screens.layout: Utilitarian yet clean list layouts. Top row of KPI cards (border, surfaceSecondary). Tabular lists for Orders, Covers, Layouts, Offers. Each list item taps into a detail/edit screen with standard form fields.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the '3 Editorial Mobile LIGHT' personality rules. The layout must feel like a premium printed magazine.
Do NOT use any blue, indigo, purple, or generic SaaS colors. Anchor the UI in warm ivory (FAFAF8), charcoal (1C1917), and terracotta (C56A47).
Enforce typography: Use Playfair Display for all Display Headings (Title, Hero text, Section headers) and Geist for body, forms, and metadata. Max font weight is 500.
Editor layout must be implemented precisely: Top portion is a sticky Reanimated preview, and the bottom is a Gorhom Bottom Sheet housing the tools.
For 'Process Bots' in the order tracking timeline, utilize Feather icons wrapped in brandTertiary circular containers. They should pulse or slightly animate to indicate active stages.
Ensure the price calculation is transparent: (sheets * 90) + 18% GST. Emphasize the final amount.
All full-bleed images with text overlays must have a vertical gradient scrim from transparent to surfaceInverse at the bottom (opacity 70%+) to guarantee WCAG readability.
No drop shadows on cards. Use 1px borders (#E6E4DD) to separate sections, staying true to the editorial flat-paper vibe.
